recentItems.title: Chinese Air Conditioning Maker Advances into High-end Machine Tool Sector
recentItems.description:
Chinese company Gree Electric Appliances, best known globally for its air conditioners, is carving out a niche in high-end machine tools.

The company transferred more than two decades of expertise in refrigeration technology to the machine tool field.

It developed its own variable-frequency cooling systems for machine tools that eliminates thermal expansion errors which can affect precision.

The company has also developed a five-axis machine tool with a repeated positioning accuracy of 0.003 millimeters, and which is primarily used in the aerospace sector.

Now, more than 75 percent of Gree's CNC production goes to external customers.

According to the China Machinery Industry Federation, China's machinery industry logged steady growth in the first half of 2026, powered by a surge in smart equipment manufacturing and high-end machine tools.

During the January-June period, major machinery enterprises generated more than two trillion US dollars in revenue, up 6.5 percent year on year.

recentItems.title: Cold-chain Logistics Keep China's Durian Craze Fresh
recentItems.description:
China is importing more durians these days, thanks to highly efficient cold-chain logistics systems.

At the customs department in south China's Shenzhen Bao'an International Airport, officials are inspecting the notoriously strong-smelling fruit.

China is the world's largest overall consumer of durians, known as the king of fruits across Southeast Asia.

Importing them by air-express has improved their freshness factor, especially for specialty durians, like these that can cost about 45 U.S. dollars.

Previously, durians were transported by ships or trucks which were costly forms of transit that led to higher prices.

But now, thanks to the China-Laos Railway, it takes around 26 hours for the fruit to arrive.

Data shows that durian imports increased roughly 31 percent from January to July this year.

Since 2022, China has been importing durians from five countries, including Vietnam and Malaysia.

recentItems.title: Son of US-born Doctor Inspired by CPC's Dedication to Helping Poor Shares Father's Story
recentItems.description:
The son of a U.S.-born doctor who journeyed to China and joined the latter part of the Red Army's historic Long March after being inspired by the cause of the Communist Party of China (CPC) has reflected on his father's remarkable tale. 
With this year marking the 90th anniversary of the Long March, the story of George Hatem, a U.S. doctor known in China by his Chinese name Ma Haide, remains one of the most enduring episodes of this time period.
